solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Demon going wrong with his excessive pursuit of pleasure

indicators.note: letters that go wrong fall out of their proper order, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A demon leads a man astray into wild indulgence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going wrong' tells you to rearrange DEMON and HIS together; 'with' just joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: A direct synonym: the philosophy or lifestyle devoted above all to seeking sensual enjoyment.

clue.text: Funny person making particular bird sound

definitions.meaning: a very amusing individual, a riot

explanation.surface: A comic does a bird impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally an entertaining person; literally the call an owl makes.

clue.text: Mad to continue churning out paper records?

indicators.note: churning stirs things up, so the letters of these three words are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Is it crazy to keep producing piles of paperwork?
explanation.definitionFit: Written evidence, files and official papers, collectively form a body of records.

clue.text: Men rush in, go berserk in one sort of residence

indicators.note: berserk means running wild, so the letters of these four words are scrambled together

explanation.surface: Men storm into a building and run riot inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A care home for the elderly or infirm is a kind of place where people live.

clue.text: Bar one type of vehicle

definitions.meaning: a lounge bar or drinking room in a pub
a car with a closed body and separate boot, called a sedan in the US

explanation.surface: Banning one kind of car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' reads as a verb, to forbid, but it is a noun, a pub room.
explanation.definitionFit: A drinking room in a pub or Western town; also the British word for a sedan car.

clue.text: Bird beginning to create racket

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, so only the start of create is used

parts.note: a racket is a loud noise, a row

explanation.surface: A noisy bird starts making a din.
explanation.walkthrough: ROW here rhymes with 'cow': a noisy disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: The black corvid is a familiar example of a bird.

clue.text: Logical, going against the ideas of left-wingers?

definitions.text: going against the ideas of left-wingers?
definitions.meaning: thinking like the political right, opposite to the left

explanation.surface: Is it reasonable to oppose what socialists believe?
explanation.definitionFit: Having sensible views; whimsically, holding the opinions of conservatives.

clue.text: Feeble-sounding objectives for periods off work maybe

indicators.note: sounding says the first piece is heard rather than seen, giving a word pronounced the same

parts.note: feeble means weak
ends are aims or goals

explanation.surface: Weak-sounding goals behind taking time off.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturdays and Sundays are typical days when people are not at their jobs; 'maybe' marks an example.

clue.text: Huge car may be actor's reward

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, a clothing label for huge sizes

explanation.surface: A film star's prize might be an enormous limousine.
explanation.definitionFit: The Academy Award statuette is the best-known prize for screen performers.

clue.text: Dish in sink getting in the way

indicators.note: one piece gets in, entering inside the other

parts.note: a lane is a way or narrow road
to sink is to sag, droop down

explanation.surface: A dirty plate left in the kitchen sink is in everyone's way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dish in sink' suggests washing-up; the first 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The baked Italian pasta in layers is a dish served at the table.

clue.text: Revolutionary Stalin as one evoking horror?

indicators.note: a revolution turns things over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Soviet dictator cast as a terrifying figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Shocking or lurid, causing a stir of shock and horror, as in tabloid stories.

clue.text: Thrown into meanest type of accommodation

indicators.note: letters thrown about land in a new order, so these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is forced into the shabbiest kind of lodging.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-contained flat on two floors is a form of housing, a kind of home.

clue.text: Noble adult at first involved in risk

indicators.note: being involved in something puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: to imperil is to put at risk

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of adult is used

explanation.surface: An aristocratic grown-up dabbles in danger.
explanation.definitionFit: Majestic and regal, befitting an emperor, so stately and grand.

clue.text: Cope with time on isle

indicators.note: one piece is placed on, following after, the other, so time comes after isle

parts.note: the Isle of Man, a British crown dependency in the Irish Sea
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone learns to deal with a long spell living on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'on' means placed after. The Isle of Man is an island lying between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: To get by with something difficult, handle it adequately: a straight synonym.

clue.text: Wood in piece of furniture gets dented

indicators.note: one piece set in, inside, the other

parts.note: a bed is a piece of bedroom furniture
ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: A wooden bed frame has picked up some knocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Something knocked hard enough to be dented has been struck, a near synonym.

clue.text: Lashes out when there is trouble

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone strikes out when bothered.
explanation.definitionFit: Bother or annoyance; a nuisance or inconvenience is a synonym.

clue.text: Girl with quiet speech drying up

parts.note: Eva is a girl's name
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: A girl gives a softly spoken address and then her voice falters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drying up' looks like forgetting one's lines, but it means losing moisture.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid turning into vapour is the process by which things become dry.

clue.text: After end of business, building is closed

indicators.note: the building comes after the letter from business
the end of a word is its last letter, here of business

parts.note: a hut is a small simple building

explanation.surface: When the working day is done the premises are locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Shut and closed are synonyms for not open.

clue.text: Coldness of manner of former company head

parts.note: ICI, Imperial Chemical Industries, a British chemical giant now gone
a ness is a headland, as in the place name Dungeness

explanation.surface: A one-time company boss had a frosty way about him.
explanation.walkthrough: ICI was a major British chemicals firm, taken over in 2008; 'head' is geographical, a promontory.
explanation.definitionFit: Frostiness, a chilly unfriendly attitude, is coldness in the figurative sense.

clue.text: Beastly sound nearby — escape finally inside

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: nigh means near, close by

indicators.note: finally points to the final letter of escape

explanation.surface: An animal noise close at hand; a creature is getting away.
explanation.definitionFit: The call of a horse is a sound made by a beast, hence 'beastly'.

clue.text: On loan for a period before Easter

definitions.meaning: the forty days of Christian fasting leading to Easter

explanation.surface: Something borrowed for the weeks leading up to Easter.
explanation.definitionFit: Past participle of lend for the first sense; the penitential church season for the second.

clue.text: Socialist land gives warning of danger

parts.note: red is a common nickname for a socialist
to light is to land or alight, as a bird does

explanation.surface: A left-wing country issues an alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'land' looks like a noun meaning a country, but it is the verb, to come down.
explanation.definitionFit: A crimson signal lamp is the standard sign to stop because of a hazard.
